name: Fan-In 50K
comments: Mirrors the Enterprise fan-in (shared subscription) case of the Open MQTT Benchmark
https://github.com/emqx/mqttbs/tree/main/results - so the numbers can be read against
theirs. Their definition: 50k publishers, 50k distinct topics, 500 subscribers on one
shared subscription, QoS 1, 16B payload, 1 msg/s per publisher (50k/s in aggregate),
Subscribers consume through a shared subscription, so a slow consumer throttles only its
own share rather than the whole topic - 500 of them split the 50k/s between them.
Shared subscription filter: $share/benchmark/test/# - group name matches theirs.
Publish topics: test/$clientindex gives test/0..test/49999, against their
test/1..test/50000: same shape, numbering offset by one.
Connections are paced at 5000/s. Without it the client opens all of them as fast as it
can - 20000 CONNECTs in half a second, some 37000/s, a rate no deployment produces and
none of these scenarios ever claimed to measure. The connect phase is setup here, not the
measurement, which starts when publishing does.
